preconditions: lead-crm/outreach_ready_canonical.json must exist with a 'ready' array containing at least one lead with a non-empty 'email' field
Python module path must include repo root so 'from commands.google_workspace import gmail_send_new' resolves
Gmail API must be enabled and the sender account must have an active OAuth/authorized credentials
lead-crm/outreach_sent_history.jsonl must be writable for deduplication

For send_cold_outreach_v2.py alternative path: ZION_SEND_ADAPTER=1 must be set, and when ZION_SEND_ADAPTER_TRIGGER=env (default) LIVE_SEND_ALLOW_SEND must be present and DRY_RUN_OUTREACH must not be '1'
For send_cold_outreach_v2.py alternative path: gog CLI must be installed and authenticated for kleber@ziontechgroup.com
residual_risks: send_cold_outreach_v2.py has no built-in single-email cap; a live run with a full leads file will dispatch to all unsent leads, not just one
send_cold_outreach_v2.py defaults to gog backend; gog CLI auth expiry or account issues will cause live failures
_small_wave_send_run.py hard-codes the repo path via a fallback chain; running from an unexpected working directory could resolve to the wrong REPO
_small_wave_send_run.py imports from commands.google_workspace; if that module is missing or broken, the script fails before sending
Both scripts append to log files; concurrent or overlapping runs can race on writes and corrupt JSONL
Gmail API rate limits (429) will stop the batch mid-run; only _small_wave_send_run.py has explicit 429 handling
send_cold_outreach_v2.py filters generic emails unless priority=alta, which can silently skip intended targets
The v2 adapter toggle (ZION_SEND_ADAPTER) is currently disabled by default, as evidenced by recent 'send_disabled' entries in outreach-send-log-campaign.jsonl
